title: No better than $10 ipsy
text: No better than ipsy.  Spend the extra 2 bucks and get boxycharm.  The allure box was tiny samples and something full size like an eyeliner or face scrub.  Something cheap.  Definitely wouldn't recommend.  I canceled thru email like the website says but was still charged another month.  Took me 3 weeks to get a refund.  I bought a few beauty boxes for my mom as a gift and this one was the least impressive
label: neutral
